title: Updates
unsupported: Development builds don’t check for updates
readyBody: Aide {{version}} has been downloaded and verified.
background: You can close this window. The download will continue in the background.
installOnQuit: This update installs when Aide quits. Restart now to use it immediately.
laterHint: Later hides the sidebar reminder for 24 hours. Quitting still installs the downloaded update.
notesMissing: Release highlights aren’t available here yet. You can read the full notes in your browser.
noHistory: Read the release history in your browser.

error.network: Couldn’t check for updates. Check your internet connection.
error.location: Aide can update itself only from the Applications folder. Move it there in Finder, then try again.
error.download: Couldn’t download the update. Aide will try again later.

install.heading: Install
install.mac: **On a Mac**, to manage your machines and tasks and run coding agents: `Aide-macos-arm64.dmg` (Apple silicon) or `Aide-macos-x64.dmg` (Intel)
install.windows: **On a Windows 11 PC**, to manage your machines and tasks and run coding agents: `Aide-windows-x64-setup.exe`, or `Aide-windows-arm64-setup.exe` on Arm. The installer isn't signed yet, so Windows will warn once; click More info › Run anyway to install
install.machine: **On a machine for coding agents** (Linux or macOS): `{{command}}`
install.device: **On an Android phone**, to follow your machines and tasks and answer your agents: the `.apk` file of this release. It doesn't come from a store, so Android asks you to allow installing it
install.cli: **For your agent's CLI**: the same command, ending with `sh -s -- --cli`
install.note: The remaining files are used by the installer and automatic updates; you don't need to download them manually.
